utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what book are we reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m sorry, I’m a bit distracted today—could you remind me which one we picked?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries—was it "The Night Circus"?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but I’d like to know the time and place first so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, fair enough — can you confirm whether the book club is at my place this Thursday evening?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday evening at your place should work for me, as long as it’s not too late. Just let me know the exact time so I can plan the ride.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the book club. What were we reading again?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I always mix that up. I think it was that mystery novel we picked last week.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the mystery novel—right. I’m in; I just need the title again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m thinking we should meet at my place next Thursday for book club, and I’ll remind everyone again tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — your place next Thursday works for me. And a reminder tomorrow will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll send the reminder tomorrow and keep the snacks simple.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—did I miss the book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Nope, you’re right on time—we were just about to decide. I’ve got a few good picks in mind if you want to toss in your vote.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, I’m in—what are the options?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple—when’s the next book club meeting, and what book are we reading?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s next Thursday at 7 at my place, and we’re reading "The Night Circus."

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, I’ll plan for next Thursday at 7. Thanks for keeping it simple.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what book are we reading for the club?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think we’re reading "The Night Circus" next — I can double-check the title if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’d be great—can you double-check it for me?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds lovely — I’d be happy to help bring everyone together for book club.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wonderful, Jules — thank you. I’ll keep track of a good spot and we can decide the details together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’m happy to help however I can, and I’ll look forward to it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa! I’d love to chat about the book club—what are you thinking for our next read?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara! I’m thinking we could go with something cozy and discussion-friendly—maybe a short novel or a memoir. If you want, I can put together a few options for us to vote on.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds lovely—yes, please send a few cozy options and I’ll happily vote. I’m excited to see what we pick!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring the extra chairs and some tea for book club. Do we still need any snacks?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, snacks would be great—maybe something simple like cookies or fruit?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I can grab cookies and some fruit too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club’s been lively lately—lots of opinions, as usual. I can tell you who’s been showing up if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, please — I’d like to know who’s been coming lately.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly Mara, June, and old Mr. Vale have been steady lately. A few folks pop in and out, but that little trio’s been the most regular.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which book club details you want me to check? I want to make sure I’ve got it right before we go further.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you check the meeting day and time, plus whether we’re still meeting at the library?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll check the meeting day and time, and confirm whether we’re still meeting at the library.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what book are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they’re picking a mystery novel this month—let me check which one and I’ll tell you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, just send me the title when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can remind everyone about the book club plans and keep folks in the loop. What time were we thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I was thinking 7:00 PM at my place. If that still works, I’ll send the details over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: 7:00 PM at your place works for me — I’ll remind everyone and keep the group updated.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, book club? Right — I think that’s tonight, isn’t it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I think so. I’m planning to go if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll try to swing by too if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’d be happy to hear what the book club’s reading next.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can check what the club picked next and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad you brought up book club, Opal. What book should we talk about first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’d start with the one we all actually finished—then we can compare notes and pick the strongest discussion points.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes perfect sense—let’s start there and make a quick list of the main themes and reactions.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but I’d want to know the time, place, and whether anyone needs me to bring something.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — we’re meeting Thursday at 7 at my place, and if you could bring a snack or a drink, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at 7 at your place works for me, and I can bring a drink. Just let me know if there’s anything specific you’d prefer.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are we actually doing the book club this week, or is that still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet — let me check the details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, can you confirm it and let me know? I’d rather not assume.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane—what’s the plan for the next book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably join a little late, but I can make it. What book are we discussing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re reading "The Secret Garden" this time, and I’ll bring a simple agenda so we can keep things on track.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but it sounds like the book club’s been lively lately. Did you want to fill me in on what I missed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it’s been a busy one—lots of good debate and a few strong opinions. I can catch you up if you want the highlights.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—give me the highlights!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I was just thinking about that. What book are we on again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re on "The Thursday Murder Club" this month.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, yes — The Thursday Murder Club. I’ve got it now; I’ll try to actually remember this one!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—let’s pick a time that doesn’t clash with school pickup. I can check my calendar and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks Faye. Just send me a couple of times that work for you, and I’ll make it fit.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do—I’ll look at after 3:30 or early evening and send you a couple options soon.
